YE-0412 Yield Excursion Root-Cause Analysis (NX-7, September 2026)
Derived summary - original not shared (source team: Process Engineering).

Final wafer-sort yield on NX-7 fell from a 92.4% baseline to 78.1% for three consecutive lots processed on ETCH-07 chamber B between 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-13. The root cause is incomplete chamber seasoning after the 2026-09-09 preventive maintenance: fluorocarbon film flaking from the new upper liner deposited particles on the wafer edge during main etch. 2026-09-09 19:30 Chamber released to production after 10 seasoning wafers instead of the 25 required by the seasoning guideline. 2026-09-13 11:00 Additional 25 seasoning wafers run; particle monitor back to 4 adders per wafer; chamber released.

Key facts:
- Final wafer-sort yield on NX-7 fell from a 92.4% baseline to 78.1% for three consecutive lots processed on ETCH-07 chamber B between 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-13.

- 2026-09-09 19:30 Chamber released to production after 10 seasoning wafers instead of the 25 required by the seasoning guideline.
- 2026-09-13 11:00 Additional 25 seasoning wafers run; particle monitor back to 4 adders per wafer; chamber released.
- Raise the post-PM seasoning requirement for chamber B from 25 to 35 wafers whenever the upper liner is replaced (owner: etch module, due 2026-10-15).
